notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Fixed issue where Bigman could not deal damage
- Added button prompt to opening dialogue
- Added a brief screen-freeze after you fall into a pit
- Standard enemies now always drop health on the final level
- Small changes to final stage layout
- Tweaks to jump
- Tweaks to analog movement
